His incredible pace, dribbling skills, and finishing ability make him a nightmare for defenders. Mbappé helped France win the World Cup in 2018 and has won several domestic titles with PSG.

2. Erling Haaland - The Norwegian striker has taken the world by storm with his incredible goal-scoring record. Haaland, who is just 20 years old, has already scored over 100 career goals for clubs and country. His incredible pace, strength, and finishing ability have made him a hot commodity among top European clubs.

3. Phil Foden - The 21-year-old English midfielder has been dubbed the "Stockport Iniesta" for his incredible ball control and passing ability. Foden has made a name for himself at Manchester City and helped the club win back-to-back Premier League titles. He has also earned his spot on the England national team.

4. Ansu Fati - The 18-year-old Spanish winger burst onto the scene with Barcelona last season, becoming the youngest scorer in the club's history. Fati's incredible dribbling skills, pace, and ability to finish with both feet have made him one of the most exciting prospects in Europe.

5. Jude Bellingham - The 18-year-old English midfielder made headlines when he moved from Birmingham City to Borussia Dortmund for a reported fee of over £25 million. Bellingham's incredible work rate, passing ability, and defensive capabilities have already seen him earn a regular spot in the Dortmund starting XI.

There are also many other young players who have the ability to become stars in the future, and it will be interesting to see how they develop over time.
